##### Project general facts

Sky Hills Astra is a striking residential development defined by its twin-tower architecture rising above a three-level podium, creating a bold yet elegant presence within Dubai’s skyline. The project offers a refined collection of residences, including studios, one-bedroom apartments with study, and spacious two-bedroom duplexes, all designed with a focus on comfort, functionality, and contemporary aesthetics. Expansive layouts, panoramic views, and a seamless integration of indoor and outdoor living spaces shape an environment where modern design meets everyday ease.

The development delivers a lifestyle centered around wellness, activity, and balance through a carefully curated range of amenities. Residents can enjoy an open-air wellness sanctuary with dedicated yoga and meditation zones, a dual-track running podium, a fully equipped fitness center, and a professional padel court. A beach-style sandy pool creates a relaxed resort atmosphere, while a private business center with a library offers a quiet space for productivity and focus. Thoughtfully designed communal areas encourage both social interaction and personal retreat.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials, creating a clean and sophisticated living environment. Fully equipped kitchens ensure practicality and convenience, seamlessly integrated into the overall design. Apartments come fully furnished, allowing residents to move into a space that is both functional and visually refined, with attention to detail that supports a comfortable and contemporary lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Science Park is a dedicated hub designed to foster innovation in science, energy, and environmental sectors. Situated in Al Barsha South, this vibrant district supports more than 350 organizations with a modern infrastructure tailored to research and development. From biotechnology and healthcare to renewable energy, Dubai Science Park is a cornerstone of Dubai’s push towards a knowledge-based economy, offering cutting-edge facilities and fostering a collaborative environment for professionals in scientific fields.

The area combines business excellence with residential convenience, providing modern housing options alongside essential amenities such as schools, fitness centers, and medical facilities. Located near Dubai Miracle Garden and with easy access to major highways, Dubai Science Park offers a well-connected and tranquil setting. Its strategic location and thoughtfully planned environment make it ideal for both families and professionals looking to balance work and personal life.

Dubai Science Park places a strong emphasis on sustainability and innovation, aligning with Dubai’s vision of an eco-conscious future. Green spaces, pedestrian-friendly areas, and community-focused amenities enhance the quality of life, while state-of-the-art laboratories and commercial spaces create opportunities for scientific advancement. This unique blend of lifestyle and professional opportunities makes Dubai Science Park a thriving community for forward-thinking individuals and businesses.
